verdict.rationale: Rainforest is a hosted payments service, so asking whether its core can be self-hosted is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable or on-premises deployment of Rainforest itself. The on-premises guide covers platforms receiving webhooks inside their own private network, and data export is a separate data-portability capability; neither is self-hosting the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
